feed_low.title: {{item}} is running low
feed_low.body: Stock lasts {{days}} days. Set minimum: {{minimum}} days.

ration_deviation.title: {{herd}}: feed use off the ration
ration_deviation.body: On {{date}} the difference was {{percent}}%: fed {{actual}}, ration {{planned}}.

lambing_soon.title: {{count}} ewes due to lamb within 7 days

lambing_overdue.title: {{count}} ewes are past their lambing date
lambing_overdue.body: Check them and enter the record.

quarantine_animals.title: In quarantine: {{count}}
quarantine_animals.body: Keep track of the quarantine period.

disk_low.title: The server's disk is nearly full
disk_low.body: {{freeGb}} GB free. Below {{stopsAtGb}} GB new files are refused, and a full disk stops the whole system. Delete files nothing uses, or ask your administrator to add space.

receipt_unpaid.title: {{docNo}}: goods received, no payment or debt recorded
receipt_unpaid.body: {{supplier}}: {{goods}}. Record the payment or the debt in Finance.

offline_conflict.title: {{herd}}: two different records for {{date}}
offline_conflict.body: A record entered offline did not match the saved one. Offline record: {{summary}}.

offline_conflict_empty.title: {{herd}}: two different records for {{date}}
offline_conflict_empty.body: A record entered offline did not match the saved one. It lists no feed.

offline_refused.title: {{herd}}: the record for {{date}} was not accepted
offline_refused.body: A record entered offline was refused and has to be entered by hand. Offline record: {{summary}}.

device_event.title: {{deviceName}}: {{eventType}}
device_event.body: It happened at {{happenedAt}}. The message reached the server late.

urgent_unreachable_not_configured.title: Urgent alerts do not leave the app
urgent_unreachable_not_configured.body: The Telegram bot is not set up, so a fire alert shows only here. Contact your administrator.

urgent_unreachable_channel_down.title: Telegram cannot be reached
urgent_unreachable_channel_down.body: The bot cannot connect to Telegram, so a fire alert would show only here. Contact your administrator.

urgent_unreachable_not_linked.title: Fire alerts have nobody to go to
urgent_unreachable_not_linked.body: Neither the owner nor a director gets urgent messages in Telegram: it is not linked, or it is turned off. Fix this on the Notifications page.

urgent_unreachable_undelivered.title: An urgent alert has reached nobody
urgent_unreachable_undelivered.body: Sending through Telegram is failing. Check the alerts here and phone the people responsible.

animal_isolated.title: {{tag}} is apart from its herd
animal_isolated.body: {{distance}} m from the rest of the flock on its last two positions.

animal_inactive.title: {{tag}} has hardly moved
animal_inactive.body: Almost still for {{hours}} hours while its herd grazed. Worth a look.

animal_fever.title: {{tag}} may have a fever
animal_fever.body: {{temperature}} °C, {{overHerd}} °C above its herd and above its own normal.

tracking_herd_split.title: {{herd}} has split up
tracking_herd_split.body: {{apart}} of {{tracked}} tracked sheep are far from the rest.

tracking_silent.title: Trackers not reporting: {{count}}
tracking_silent.body: No reading for over {{hours}} hours. Check the collars, or whether the flock is out of the gateway's reach.

tracking_silent_all.title: No tracker is reporting
tracking_silent_all.body: None of {{total}} trackers sent anything for {{hours}} hours. Check the gateway, its power and internet, and the network server.

crop_weak_zone.title: Weak spots in field {{field}}: {{areaHa}} ha
crop_weak_zone.body: The satellite image of {{date}} shows weak zones: {{count}}. Walk to them and check for pests, water and nutrients.

satellite_no_green_up.title: Field {{field}}: no crop seen since sowing
satellite_no_green_up.body: Sown on {{date}}, but the satellite still sees bare soil. Check the emergence, or correct the sowing date.

satellite_harvest_not_seen.title: Field {{field}}: harvest recorded, crop still standing
satellite_harvest_not_seen.body: A harvest is recorded on {{date}}, but the satellite still sees a green crop. Check the record.

satellite_unrecorded_harvest.title: Field {{field}}: crop removed, no harvest recorded
satellite_unrecorded_harvest.body: Around {{date}} the satellite saw the crop removed (harvest, cutting or defoliation). Record the harvest if it took place.

spray_window.title: Spraying field {{field}}: {{date}} is unsuitable
spray_window.body: Wind, rain or heat will spoil the treatment. Best time: {{bestDate}}, {{bestFrom}}–{{bestTo}}.

spray_window_none.title: Spraying field {{field}}: {{date}} is unsuitable
spray_window_none.body: The forecast has no suitable hours in the next days. Move the treatment.

heat_stress.title: Heat for the flock: {{date}}, {{from}}–{{to}}
heat_stress.body: The heat index for sheep reaches {{thi}} (extreme). Keep the animals in shade, give plenty of water, and do not drive or shear them in these hours.

irrigation_due.title: Field {{field}}: watering due {{date}}
irrigation_due.body: The crop will soon use up the water it takes up easily. About {{m3}} m³ refills the root zone.

irrigation_due_now.title: Field {{field}}: watering is due now
irrigation_due_now.body: The crop has used up the water it takes up easily and starts to suffer. About {{m3}} m³ refills the root zone.

bot.linked: Your account is linked. {{status}} shows today's status, {{alerts}} shows open alerts, {{help}} shows everything I can do.
bot.linkFailed: That code is wrong or has expired. Get a new one on the Notifications page.
bot.notLinked: This chat is not linked to an account. Get a code on the Notifications page.
bot.help:
Just write to me: ask how the farm is doing, or tell me about money and I will prepare a record for you to confirm. Voice notes and photos of receipts work too.

{{status}} today's status
{{alerts}} open alerts
{{pending}} records waiting for you
{{new}} start a new conversation
{{farm}} choose the farm
{{help}} this help
bot.noFarm: Your account is not attached to a farm.
bot.blocked: Your access is blocked. Please contact your administrator.
bot.groupOnly: I only work in a private chat. Please write to me directly.
bot.enroll2fa: Your role requires two-factor protection. Turn it on in the web app, then come back.
bot.noAssistant: The assistant is not open to your role. {{status}} and {{alerts}} still work.
bot.apology: Sorry, something went wrong on my side. Please try again in a moment.
bot.rateLimited: That is too many messages. Please wait about {{minutes}} min and try again.
bot.tooLong: That message is too long. Please keep it under {{limit}} characters.
bot.fileTooLarge: That file is too large. The limit is {{limit}} MB.
bot.voiceTooLong: That voice note is too long. Please keep it under {{limit}} minutes.
bot.unsupported: I can read text, voice notes, photos and PDF files.
bot.nothingHeard: I could not make anything out. Please say it again or type it.
bot.waitingApproval: Recorded. It now waits for a second person's approval.
bot.stale: This button is out of date.
bot.cardChanged: This card has changed. Please check it and confirm again.
bot.moneyHidden: This record holds money details your role cannot see.
bot.noRightToAcknowledge: Only the people responsible, the owner or the director can acknowledge this alert.
bot.acknowledgeAsk: This record has something to check, shown above. Record it anyway?
bot.needsAnswer: This card is waiting for your answer. Please answer the question first.
bot.cardStale: Something on this card changed or closed, so it was not recorded. Change it or cancel it.
bot.chooseFarm: You work on several farms. Choose which one this chat works for, then send your message again.
bot.currentFarm: This chat now works for: {{farm}}. You can choose another below.
bot.otherFarm: This card belongs to another farm. Switch to it with {{farm}} and press again.
bot.notInBooks: This record is not in the books: it was refused or voided.
bot.pendingMore: {{count}} more are waiting. Deal with these first, or open them in the web app.
bot.moveAsk: This chat belongs to {{current}}, and the code is for {{next}}. Move this chat to {{next}}? {{current}} would stop getting messages and confirming here.
bot.moved: This chat now belongs to {{next}}. {{current}} is no longer linked here.
bot.movedAway: Your account was linked to another Telegram chat, so this chat no longer works for it. If this was not you, unlink the new chat on the Notifications page and change your password.
bot.unlinked: This chat was unlinked from your account.
bot.editIgnored: I do not read edited messages. To correct a record, press Change on its card or write a new message.

linkNotice.title: Telegram linked
linkNotice.body: {{name}} can now act on your account through Telegram. If this was not you, unlink it on the Notifications page and change your password.

bot.sendAsPhoto: I cannot read this type of file. Please send it as a photo.
bot.unlinkedBlocked: Your account was blocked, so this chat was unlinked. Alerts will no longer come here. Please contact your administrator.

unlinkNotice.title: Telegram unlinked
unlinkNotice.body: This account no longer gets alerts in Telegram and cannot confirm from there. Link it again on the Notifications page.

twoFactorNotice.title: Two-factor sign-in changed
twoFactorNotice.body: Two-factor sign-in on your account was reset, replaced, or a recovery code was used. If this was not you, contact your administrator at once.

inviteNotice.title: Invitation to a farm
inviteNotice.body: "{{workspace}}" invited you to join. Sign in to the app to accept or decline.

passwordNotice.title: Password changed
passwordNotice.body: The password of your account was changed, and other devices were signed out. This Telegram chat stays linked. If this was not you, contact your administrator at once.

bot.waitForAnswer: I am still answering your last message. Wait for the answer, check the card, then confirm.
bot.farmAfterTurn: I will answer what you already wrote first, then switch the farm.
bot.escalated: Sent to you because it could not reach the people responsible.

errors.ALERT_NOT_OPEN: This alert has already been handled
errors.ALERT_NOT_YOURS: Only the people responsible, the owner or the director can stop this urgent alert
errors.TELEGRAM_NOT_CONFIGURED: The Telegram bot is not set up yet. Contact your administrator.
errors.AI_AUDIO_NOT_SUPPORTED: The current AI provider cannot read voice notes. Please type your message.
errors.AI_TRANSCRIPTION_FAILED: The voice note could not be read. Please say it again or type it.

title: Alerts
description: Problems found by rules and AI, in one list, by severity.

inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.description: Your messages, and where you receive them.

settings.channelsBody: Messages inside the platform are always on. You choose the rest.
settings.urgentOffTitle: Turn off urgent alerts in Telegram?
settings.urgentOffBody: Telegram is the only channel outside the platform right now. Turn it off and you will hear about a fire or a sick animal only when you open the app.
settings.urgentOff: Urgent alerts do not reach you in Telegram, so you would hear about a fire only in the app. Tick Telegram to turn them back on.

testAlert.title: Test alert
testAlert.body: Shows who an urgent alert reaches. Each member of staff gets one message labelled as a test, and no real alert is raised.
testAlert.confirmBody: It goes to all the staff of this farm.
testAlert.inAppBody: The message is in each person's notifications.
testAlert.nobody: This farm has no staff to send it to.

reason.not_linked: Telegram not linked, or the bot is blocked
reason.turned_off: Turned Telegram off for urgent messages
reason.failed: Telegram did not answer, it will be tried again
reason.not_configured: The Telegram bot is not set up

message.title: TEST: this is not a real alert
message.body: Nothing has happened on the farm. This message checks that urgent alerts reach you. There is nothing to do.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.body: Get alerts and the daily summary in Telegram. Send the bot /holat to see today's status.
telegram.notConfigured: The Telegram bot is not set up yet. Contact your administrator.
telegram.unlinkBody: This account will stop receiving Telegram messages.
telegram.step2: Send the bot the command below.

telegram.waiting: Waiting for the bot. The code works until {{time}}.
